scientific_conclusions.mo93m_neec_status: The 1% depletion claim of Chiara 2018 is challenged by target-contamination analysis (Guo 2021) and refuted under secondary isomer-beam stopping conditions (Guo 2022, P_max ~ 2e-5, derived from 3-sigma background lower bound). Standard NEEC theory predicts ~10^-11, which remains unobserved but physically viable.
scientific_conclusions.geometry_dependence: Solid carbon beam-foil stopping is subject to rapid stopping, charge-state cooling, and secondary reactions. Clean monoenergetic platforms (EBIT, storage rings with electron coolers) avoid stopping losses and Doppler broadening.
scientific_conclusions.cross_region_transfer: Depletion mechanisms depend on nuclear structure: spherical shell-model isomers (direct multipole coupling to core-coupled states) vs deformed K-isomers (step-wise K-mixing via intermediate bands, as in 180Ta). Continuous energy-sharing channels (NETP) and vortex electron beams (OAM matching) offer alternative theoretical pathways.
